start.greeting: ⚔️ {game} The whole world map is split into sectors. Play for your city and clan, earn coins and capture territory! Tap the button below to open the game.
help.text: {game} /start — open the game /newclan — create a clan from your channel or group /help — help /terms — terms /privacy — privacy /paysupport — payment support
terms.text: This is an entertainment game. In-game coins have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn. Telegram Stars purchases only grant in-game benefits.
privacy.text: We store only your Telegram ID, name, username and game progress. Data is not shared with third parties.
paysupport.text: For payment questions, message the administrator: describe the purchase and its date. We reply within 48 hours.
newclan.intro: ⚔️ Create a clan A clan is your channel or group. Members join by link and fight for you on the world map. 1. Tap the button below and pick a channel or group where you are an admin. 2. Telegram will offer to add the bot as an admin — accept: the bot needs it to check subscriptions and post. Minimum: {min_channel} channel subscribers or {min_group} group members.
newclan.not_admin: Only an admin of this chat can create a clan.
newclan.bot_not_admin: The bot is not in this chat (in a channel it must be an admin). Add the bot and try again: /newclan
newclan.too_small: Not enough members: at least {n} are required.
newclan.bad_title: The chat title did not pass moderation. Rename the chat and try again.
newclan.created: ✅ Clan {title} created! Join link: {link} Share it with your audience: everyone who opens it can join the clan.
newclan.error: Could not check the chat. Please try again later.
clan.btn.post: 📣 Post an invite in the chat
clan.post.text: ⚔️ {title} joins «{game}»! The whole world map is split into sectors. Open the game, join our clan and help us capture our city!
clan.post.failed: Could not post: the bot is not allowed to write in this chat.
clan.not_owner: Only the clan creator can change this.
clan.group.none: This chat has no clan yet. An admin can create one: send /newclan to the bot in private messages
